plain_english_revision: The amendment modifies how members of a new regulatory body (the Alabama Gaming Commission) are selected, specifically requiring that one of the three gubernatorial appointments come from a slate nominated by the Alabama Black Legislative Caucus. It also increases the total number of gubernatorial appointees from 'One' to 'Two'.
candidate_position_supported: Affirmatively advances a policy effect that ensures representation on the Alabama Gaming Commission by requiring gubernatorial appointees to be selected from slates proposed by the Alabama Black Legislative Caucus.
evidence_quotes: One of the members appointed by the Governor, the Lieutenant Governor, and the Speaker of the House of Representatives shall each be appointed from a slate of three individuals proposed by the Alabama Black Legislative Caucus.
On page 20, lines 1 and 4, delete 'One' and insert in lieu thereof the following: Two
review_reason: The amendment text is clear and unambiguous regarding its changes to the bill's structure.
